name: fabien-skills
description: A bundle of reusable agentic skills. Currently: make-plan (write durable, resumable plan directories), fix-stale-doc (full-repo documentation sweep), catch-up (personal Slack/Jira/GitHub catch-up dashboard), capture-docs (session-end capture of learnings into repo docs), pr-review (review a PR locally or push a consolidated, continuity-aware review comment), idea (capture project ideas into a docs/IDEA.md backlog), gitmoji (commit with a gitmoji-prefixed message), tmp-cleanup (free RAM by deleting stale /tmp entries), close-session (session wrap-up: tickets, Slack PR reactions, docs PR, scratch cleanup), eta (ETA of the current task in a fixed format, with timings learned from past commands via bundled hooks).
